findings.quote: Eleven days before the loop began coming back rich, a machine at Bittern had told a machine at Cold Harbor something no one aboard had decided to say.
findings.claim: Eleven is the length of the surplus run, not the gap from the Day −29 pull to the Day −11 onset, which is eighteen days.
findings.fix: State the true gap; the timestamp is canon, so the offset is what changes.
findings.note: Same defect as the continuity finding, quoted shorter. One repair closed both.
